markets: Global: Milan, Paris and Florence runways; premium and mid-market menswear
title: SS27 Men's Short Story
summary: Proportions shrink: micro jackets, cropped blousons, shorts and boxer shorts worn as outerwear replace the long, oversized line.

sections.heading: The story
sections.body:
Hypebeast named "the micro jacket" one of the defining SS27 menswear trends: shrunken, cropped and body-hugging micro peacoats, collarless trucker jackets with raw edges, bombers and blousons at Celine, Junya Watanabe, Prada and Willy Chavarria<sup>[1]</sup>. Prada paired leather with slim five-pocket trousers and cropped jackets with flat pockets that worked as shirts<sup>[2]</sup>. Below the waist, Dolce & Gabbana showed microshorts<sup>[2]</sup> and boxer shorts left the bedroom: worn bare, above the waistline or as outerwear at JW Anderson, Willy Chavarria and Dries Van Noten, in gingham and stripes at GmbH and Charles Jeffrey Loverboy<sup>[1]</sup>.

Heat was the driver. Hypebeast's verdict: "the beating sun is the true main character of SS27"<sup>[1]</sup>.

sections.heading: Colours
sections.body: Sand, tobacco and ice blue from the SS27 menswear palette, with rust and salmon pink as accents. See SS27 Men's Season Colours.

sections.heading: Silhouettes
sections.body:
- Cropped blousons and micro trucker jackets ending at the waist.
- Slim five-pocket trousers and closer-cut long trousers.
- Tailored shorts and boxer-style shorts in shirting.

sections.heading: Fabrics
sections.body: Leather, including woven and perforated leather for breathability<sup>[2]</sup>; gingham and striped shirting cottons; denim.

sections.heading: Trims and details
sections.body: Flat patch pockets, raw edges, elastic and button-fly waistbands on boxer shorts, minimal hardware.

timing: In stores February to July 2027. Cropped jackets are rising; boxer shorts as outerwear are an early, younger-customer idea.
products:
- Cropped leather and suede blousons; micro trucker jackets; tailored and boxer-style shorts; slim five-pocket trousers.
- Customers: fashion-forward men under 35 first; the cropped blouson reaches a broad audience.
design_implications:
- Re-cut jacket blocks shorter: hem at or just above the waist, with a slimmer sleeve.
- Design boxer shorts with real outerwear construction: fly, pockets, a stable waistband.
- Balance short jackets with full or straight trousers for wider customers.
commercial_implications:
- Add depth to cropped blousons; keep boxer shorts as a test.
- Shorts carry the high-summer drop; plan them as a coordinated category with shirts.
